# Vendored maven artifacts

The Spotube gradle plugin (`dev.krtirtho.spotube:plugin:0.1.1` + its plugin marker)
is not published to Maven Central or the Gradle plugin portal. It is vendored here
so the build needs no local publish of the plugin first. Upstream:
github.com/team-spotube/gradle-plugin (same version 0.1.1), Apache-2.0.
